Profile Thiocolchicoside is a muscle relaxant that has been claimed to possess GABA-mimetic and glycinergic actions. It is used in the symptomatic treatment of painful muscle spasm (p.1887). The usual initial oral dose is 16 mg daily given in 2 divided doses. It has also been given intramuscularly, in doses up to 8 mg daily, or applied as cream or ointment. Photosensitivity reactions may oc- cur. USP 31 (Tizanidine Hydrochloride). Store in airtight containers. Adverse Effects and Precautions Tizanidine hydrochloride may cause drowsiness; patients affect- ed should not drive or operate machinery. Other adverse effects include dry mouth, fatigue, dizziness or vertigo, muscle pain and weakness
